scoring_justification: Full DMFT+SUNCA recompute is infeasible due to computational cost; scoring compares the agent's reported thermopower values to hidden experimental gold with tolerance.

hidden_assets.purpose: Experimental thermopower reference values for La1-xSrxTiO3 at 300 K from Tokura et al. (Ref. 40 of the source paper).
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table II, row 'Experiment' for dopings 5%, 25%, 50%, 75%, 80%.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Values manually extracted from the paper's published Table II.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual published experimental measurements the paper compares against; using them ensures the reproduction must match the established experimental data.

outputs.description: CSV file with computed thermopower values for five doping levels.

output_contract.notes: Only thermopower is scored; the experimental reference values from Tokura et al. (Ref. 40 of the source paper) are used as hidden gold. No intermediate numerical values or tolerances are disclosed.
